The '''Esus Mesa''' was a stone mesa located in the [[Jundland Chasm/Legends|Jundland Chasm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was connected to nearby cliffs by a stone bridge.<ref name="Duel" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Praven]] challenged a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]] to a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel on the Esus Mesa|duel]] atop the Esus Mesa, where the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi]] defeated Praven in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]].<ref name="Duel" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Esus Mesa was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], where it appears as a class story area for the Jedi Knight class's mission "Desert Duel."<ref name="Duel" />
